description: Documents that every conforming reader MUST reject (structural or semantic validation). The cross-language negative contract; the harness asserts only that parsing is rejected.

cases.name: op_exp_extra_params
cases.reason: exp is parameterless; a params object is invalid (op params MUST NOT be silently ignored)

cases.name: op_affine_unknown_param
cases.reason: affine accepts only a and b; an extra key c is invalid

cases.name: bulk_shape_mismatch
cases.reason: declared shape [5] but only 3 decoded elements

cases.name: bulk_truncated_buffer
cases.reason: 20-byte float64 buffer is not a whole multiple of the 8-byte item size

cases.name: mixture_weights_length_mismatch
cases.reason: one weight but two components (weights/components must align by index)

cases.name: capability_lie_abs
cases.reason: abs is non-invertible so can_log_prob must be false; the document declares it true

cases.name: future_major_version
cases.reason: format MAJOR 2 exceeds the implemented major and must be rejected, not guessed

cases.name: transform_over_discrete_base
cases.reason: change-of-variables applies to densities; a transform over a discrete (poisson) base is invalid
